description: On a light green tablecloth, several small colorful plates sit near the right side of the table. The right hand reaches in and slides a green plate aside to unstack it from a yellow plate, sets the green plate down to the left, then lifts and places the yellow plate lower on the table; next the hand grips a red plate that’s stacked on a blue plate, pulls the red plate to the far right to separate it, and leaves the blue plate in the middle.
